newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra fall drags Swedish shares to lower close.
newsitem.headline: Astra fall drags Swedish shares to lower close.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Thursday, falling from record high levels, in what brokers called a broad correction with drugs major Astra leading the tumble.
The general index fell 0.81 percent to 3,163.51 in turnover of 4.9 billion crowns, substantial for the summer season.
Astra led the downturn after announcing sales of its ulcer drug Losec in the U.S. rose 28 percent to $1.02 billion in the first half of 1997 against a year ago.
"We had expected a sales increase of about 40 percent," said one broker.

"We noticed the share price was hit right after the figures but it wasn't until foreign investors went in that it was really traded down. I am worried about how the share price will go tomorrow," one broker said.
Astra closed six crowns lower at 151 crowns.
Telecoms group Ericsson touched a record high of 349 but closed down 2.5 crowns at 338.
"I believe the share will go up tomorrow. One big seller came right before market close and that is what is pushing the share down," one broker said.
Banks and insurance companies were also hit. Skandia slid 12 to 325 crowns.
